name: Cloudflare

What Cloudflare says to expect

  • Fourth quarter fiscal 2026: outlookFor the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, we expect: • Total revenue of $845.0 to $846.0 million • Non-GAAP income from operations of $156.0 to $157.0 million • Non-GAAP net income per share of $0.43, utilizing weighted average common shares outstanding of approximately 379 million
  • Full year fiscal 2026: outlookFor the full year fiscal 2026, we expect: • Total revenue of $2,963.0 to $2,964.0 million • Non-GAAP income from operations of $462.0 to $463.0 million • Non-GAAP net income per share of $1.35, utilizing weighted average common shares outstanding of approximately 376 million
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 5, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
